name: Refine the wording and tone of specific messages
description: Users asked to rewrite, edit, or polish specific messages, emails, and drafts to improve clarity, professionalism, tone, or conciseness. The requests covered a wide range of contexts, including business correspondence, personal notes, technical updates, and formal announcements, often with specific instructions to retain key information or adjust the style (e.g., more formal, casual, or direct).
